verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Copilot is built into GitHub with nothing to install, and users can delegate coding tasks to the Copilot cloud agent without leaving GitHub.com. The agent researches the repo, plans, makes changes on a branch and opens a pull request; tasks can be assigned from issues or mobile, and a central page tracks agent sessions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the delegation workflow, since all evidence is vendor documentation.
